name: KiCad Project Initialization Plugin
description: Create KiCad, PlatformIO and ESP-IDF component projects from the project template
description_full: This plugin creates a new project from the bundled project template or updates the metadata of an existing project. New projects can be a KiCad hardware project, a hardware project with PlatformIO firmware, a PlatformIO firmware project or an ESP-IDF component. The plugin applies the PCB template, renames the project files, sets the text variables of the .kicad_pro file (PROJECT_NAME, BOARD_NAME, DESIGNER, COMPANY, REVISION, RELEASE_DATE), keeps the GitHub workflows of the project type and replaces the placeholders of the template.
